data.define: A playful way to say something is very simple.

misuse.text: Don't say 'easy peasy' about a friend's hard task.
misuse.why: It makes their struggle look small.

publish.title: What does "easy peasy" mean?
publish.value: Easy peasy = That's super easy. Example: "Making toast is easy peasy." (casual English, UK).
